entries.aa9e0422561e8fda: With the philosophy of "Solve social issues in education and welfare, and create a better future," the company states that it aims to realize a better future through "providing high-quality education" and "creating a comfortable working environment." In the education personnel support business, it will expand referrals of teachers and club activity instructors and the dispatch of ICT support staff, and in the welfare personnel support business, its policy is to subdivide its job site by the needs of each job type to prevent turnover due to mismatches. entries.b3aa328ced5f8cd1: In schools, long working hours for teachers and teacher shortages have become issues, and the use of external personnel such as club activity instructors and ICT support staff is spreading.
